plan.summary: BRO-6493: correct Prince Faggot Studio Seaview opening using producer production history
steps: BRO-6493: Soho Rep production history explicitly dates the Studio Seaview opening September 11 and closing December 13, 2025. September 10 was an added first performance, described as a first preview by TheaterMania. Prefer the producing company retrospective over listing pages that label the first performance opening. Sources: https://www.sohorep.org/shows/prince-faggot/ https://www.theatermania.com/news/prince-faggot-will-have-a-return-off-broadway-engagement_1795576/ https://www.broadwayworld.com/off-broadway/article/PRINCE-FAGGOT-Announces-30-First-Performance-at-Studio-Seaview-20250908
